payload.authorization: User-authorized zero-oracle attempt_2 correcting only the sealed attempt_1 WHERE search and sparse conditional-policy failures.
payload.scientific_problem: Learn a source-conditioned distribution over complete address-free dependency-region target patches while guaranteeing declared WHERE support for every nonempty current-graph role set.
payload.primary_output: One target-independent runtime checkpoint per frozen whole-source fold containing a structured WHERE policy and a shared feature-conditioned autoregressive whole-patch policy.
payload.claim_under_test: Shared graph/prefix features with training-only source-group calibration improve held-source complete-patch ordering over the unchanged balanced marginal without changing grammar, runtime, compiler, or candidate budget.
payload.validation_setting: The unchanged three whole-source folds over 77 routes and 147 complete regions, CPU-only and zero-oracle, with a 128-candidate diagnostic budget.

frozen.split: whole source; one seed per protein held in each fold

where.declared_support: all nonempty subsets of the current graph live roles
where.canonical_decoder: address-free graph-feature-conditioned include/exclude mask over canonical current-role order
where.legality: last role forced included only when the prefix selected no role
where.inference: deterministic beam; common diagnostic pool from learned and marginal beams; no teacher insertion counted as autonomous
report: beam candidates before and after deduplication

patch_policy.stream: unchanged canonical autoregressive whole StructuralSubgoal token stream
patch_policy.features: shared deterministic hashed source-graph, source-region and complete-prefix features
patch_policy.heads: regularized multinomial logistic conditional head per factor/token-kind with a shared feature schema
patch_policy.balancing: equal source mass, within source equal route mass, within route equal region and decision mass
patch_policy.feature_cache: materialize each outer-fold matrix once and reuse it for every head and internal LOSO fit

prefit_gates.on_failure: publish missing taxonomy and stop before fitting

gate3.comparison: learned attempt_2 versus unchanged source-balanced marginal under identical diagnostic candidate fibers and 128 budget
gate3.promotion: learned must materially beat marginal under this frozen contract; no post-result relaxation

gate4.on_gate3_failure: publish blocked exactly as attempt_1 with zero autonomous claims

prohibitions: Do not change the complete-region grammar, runtime, compiler, realizer, folds, corpus, candidate budgets or seeds.
Do not fit on an outer held source or derive a vocabulary/statistic from it.
Do not decode executor primitive traces.
Do not tune a selector, value model, Dynamic controller or scoring function.
Do not call an oracle or docking function, launch Modal, use the network or access a live run.
Do not relax a gate after inspecting results.
